name: Army-Navy Basic Finner (DRDC 30 mm free-flight model)
_notes: Geometry of the Army-Navy Basic Finner free-flight model in DREV-TM-9703, the report its anchors are read from (see the series sources in anchors.json). d = 30.00 mm, total 10.0 cal.
Nose: 10 deg half-angle sharp cone, length 2.836 cal (meplat 0.004 cal ignored).

Fins: 4 rectangular, 1.0 x 1.0 cal, flush with base. Section: sharp-LE single wedge thickening to 0.08 cal at the blunt TE - modeled exactly with the feature-#4 'singlewedge' airfoil section (thickness wave tau^2/beta + fin base drag; the 0.004-cal LE radius is essentially sharp, left 0).
Anchor Cx0 includes base drag at flight Re (free-flight data).
